product.name: Designer Saree with Blouse
product.short_description: A saree with a Colour variation axis AND an optional stitched Blouse add-on — composed together.
product.description:
Banarasi Silk Saree is a Saha Textile signature — a piece where heritage craftsmanship meets a modern, everyday sensibility.

Every saree in this collection begins with carefully sourced yarn and an eye for detail that machine-made pieces simply cannot replicate. The result is a finish that feels as considered up close as it looks from across the room — supple to the touch, true in colour, and built to hold its shape and sheen through years of wear.

Styling it is effortless. Dress it up for weddings, festive gatherings and celebrations, or keep it understated for a workday or an evening out — the Banarasi Silk Saree moves comfortably between occasions without ever feeling out of place. Pair it with contrast accessories to make it pop, or let its own detailing take centre stage.

Why you'll love it

  • Handpicked, premium-quality material chosen for comfort and longevity.
  • Rich, colour-fast dyes that stay vivid wash after wash.
  • Finished by skilled artisans with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Versatile enough to carry from daytime ease to festive elegance.

Care: Dry clean recommended for the first wash; thereafter a gentle hand-wash in cold water with a mild detergent will keep the fabric and colours at their best. Dry in shade and store folded with a muslin wrap to preserve the weave.

At Saha Textile, each piece is a small promise — of authenticity, of craft, and of the joy of wearing something made with genuine care. We hope the Banarasi Silk Saree earns a lasting place in your collection.
